subtitle: 要參加姊姊的婚禮，寫信向老師請假
task: You will miss your math class on Friday because you are going to your sister's wedding in another city. Write a short email to your teacher, Mr. Brown. Tell him why you will be absent and ask about the homework.
taskZh: 你這週五要去外縣市參加姊姊的婚禮，會缺席數學課。寫一封簡短的 email 給 Brown 老師：說明缺席原因，並詢問作業。
focus: 清楚說明缺席的日期與原因
email 格式正確（稱呼、結尾）

en: I am writing to tell you that I will be absent from math class this Friday. My sister is getting married in Kaohsiung, and my family will leave on Thursday night.
Could you tell me what homework I need to do? I will hand it in on Monday. I will also ask a classmate for the notes.
zh: 我寫信是要告訴您，這週五我將無法來上數學課。我姊姊要在高雄結婚，我們全家週四晚上就會出發。
可以請您告訴我需要做哪些作業嗎？我會在星期一交。我也會向同學借筆記。

patterns.pattern: I am writing to tell you that I will be absent from …

parts: My sister is getting married in Kaohsiung.
My family will leave on Thursday night.
